title: HB 6001 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2; Title 4; Title 5; Title 6; Title 7; Title 8 and Title 55, relative to non-United States citizens.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec 10, 2-7-112(c)(1) and (c)(3) (accepted ID: temporary licences excluded)
(quote) (1) A Tennessee driver license that is not a temporary driver license; (3) A Tennessee photo identification license issued pursuant to § 55-50-336 that is not a temporary photo identification license;
(section) Sec 14, new 55-50-331 (1) (temporary licence not valid ID where only citizens are eligible, including voting)
(quote) A temporary license or permit shall not be used and must not be accepted as valid identification where eligibility for a right or benefit is exclusive to United States citizens, including, but not limited to, voting.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec 14, 55-50-331 (3) (visual marker on temporary licences; ties to voting: yes)
(quote) A temporary driver license, temporary photo identification license, or temporary permit must include a visually distinctive marker for the class designation on the face of the license to distinguish the temporary license from the license issued to United States citizens under § 55-50-303(a)(9) that is used as a photo identification for voting purposes.
(section) Sec 12, 55-50-321(c)(1)(C) (citizenship documents for licence or photo ID, at issuance; not a voting check itself)
(quote) Any applicant applying for a driver license, instruction permit, intermediate driver license, or photo identification license, upon initial issuance or reinstatement, shall provide either an original or certified copy of documentation that the applicant is a citizen of the United States.
(section) Sec 14 (4) (permanent residents renewing after 2026-01-01 must prove citizenship or get a temporary licence)
(quote) A lawful permanent resident who renews or reinstates a driver license, permit, or photo identification license on or after January 1, 2026, must provide proof of United States citizenship to maintain the driver license, permit, or photo identification license.
(other) Sec 1: creates the centralized immigration enforcement division in the department of safety, with a chief immigration enforcement officer.
(other) Sec 2: 4-3-2015(a) agreement with the U.S. attorney general under the 287(g) program.
(other) Secs 3-4 and 7-8: Class E felony for an official who violates the sanctuary-policy bars (state and local), and removal-from-office action by the attorney general after conviction.
(other) Sec 5: immigration enforcement grant program and fund (grants to local governments and agencies with 287(g) agreements).
(other) Sec 6: a law enforcement agency may negotiate a 287(g) agreement without governing-body approval.
(other) Sec 9: adds the chief immigration enforcement officer to the 7-68-105(c)(1) notice list.
(other) Sec 11: 55-50-303(a)(9) licence class limited to U.S. citizens (permanent residents removed).
(other) Sec 13: 55-50-321(i)(1) proof of citizenship (or lawful status for a temporary licence) when presenting a licence from a state that licenses unlawfully present people.
(other) Sec 15: 55-50-102(56) definition change for lawful permanent residents.
(other) Sec 16: severability.
(other) Sec 17: effective dates: Secs 1, 2, 5, 9 expire 2029-01-20 unless reauthorized; Secs 3, 4, 7, 8 effective 2025-07-01; Secs 10-15 effective 2026-01-01.
(other) version: 3073731-Draft (2025-01-22): 16 sections. Carries slot a text in a narrower form: Sec 9 adds only 'that is not a temporary driver license' to 2-7-112(c)(1); (c)(3) photo ID is not touched. Carries the 55-50-331(g) temporary-licence bar on use as valid ID (voting named) and the visual marker.
(other) version: HA6031 (Immigration committee amendment 1, Todd, 2025-01-29, flag 0): rewrites Sec 9 to cover both (c)(1) and (c)(3); adds a sentence moving the 287(g) provision to a new Sec 6; reworks Sec 5 and the effective-date clause. Carries slot a text. Its wording is in the Chaptered act.
(other) version: HA6032 (Immigration committee amendment 2, Todd, flag 0): adds confidentiality subsection to Sec 1 and rewrites Sec 5 (grant program). No slot a-e text. In the Chaptered act.
(other) version: HA6033 (Johnson, flag 0): makes Secs 1-8 unenforceable unless federally funded. No slot a-e text. Not in Chaptered.
(other) version: HA6034 (Johnson, flag 0): deletes subdivision (3) of Sec 13 (the temporary-licence marker). Would have struck slot e. Not in Chaptered (marker is in the act).
(other) version: HA6040 (Dixie, flag 0): adds a 1,000-foot safe-zone bar on immigration enforcement. No slot a-e text. Not in Chaptered.
(other) version: HA6038 (Jones J, flag 0): deletes Secs 3 and 6 (felony sections) and changes effective dates. No slot a-e text. Not in Chaptered.
(other) version: HA6048 (Dixie, flag 0): safe-zone wording in Sec 1(b)(4). No slot a-e text. Not in Chaptered.
(other) version: HA6049 (Pearson, flag 0): deletes Secs 3-4 (state-level felony and removal). No slot a-e text. Not in Chaptered.
(other) version: HA6050 (Pearson, flag 0): deletes the local sanctuary-vote felony section. No slot a-e text. Not in Chaptered.
(other) version: HA6051 (Pearson, flag 0): deletes the 55-50-321(i)(1) and 55-50-331(g) sections, which hold the temporary-licence bar on voting use and the marker. Would have struck slots a (Sec 14 part) and e. Not in Chaptered (those sections are in the act).
(other) version: 3238982-Chaptered (2025-02-14, Public Chapter 1 of the First Extraordinary Session = Senate Bill 2, substituted for HB 6001): 17 sections; carries slots a and e text. Sec 10 covers both (c)(1) and (c)(3) with the 'not a temporary' wording from HA6031.
(other) note: Immigration-enforcement bill; voting language is only Sec 10 (accepted-ID list) and Sec 14 (temporary licences not valid for voting). The ten saved amendments are all flagged adopted 0 and carry no adoption date; they say 'AMEND Senate Bill No. 6002*', the extraordinary-session companion number. The Chaptered act contains the wording of HA6031 and HA6032 only, so those two are inferred to be the committee amendments. The House passed Senate Bill 2 in place of HB 6001 on 2025-01-30 ('Comp. SB subst.'); no House floor roll call is saved under HB 6001 and the Senate's roll calls are not in the skeleton. 'Sec 14 (1)' in the Chaptered copy reads '(9)' in the section number of the instruction ('55-50-331(9)'); the Draft and HA6031 read '55-50-331(g)'.

votes.motion: Committee recommended for passage if amended [version voted: Draft + HA6031 + HA6032 (committee amendments 1 and 2; inferred from 'if am', same-day dates, and the Chaptered text containing both; the other eight amendments are not in the Chaptered act)]
